title: Shadow Slave
description: Sunny, a young man born in the slums, is infected by the mysterious Nightmare Spell and dragged into a deadly Nightmare. After surviving against impossible odds, he awakens with supernatural abilities and a dangerous flaw tied to his Aspect. Thrown into a world of ancient ruins, monsters, Awakened warriors, and forgotten gods, Sunny must use his cunning and unique powers to survive while uncovering the terrifying truth behind the Nightmare Spell.
author: Guiltythree
artist: Dungeon Crawler Carl Webcomic Production Team
